newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields mixed on latest Saudi treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields mixed on latest Saudi treasury bills.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills was steady at 5.6750 percent and the rate on 91-day bills was also flat at 5.7936 percent.
The 182-day bills maturing on December 4 were little changed to 5.9207 percent from 5.9206 and the 364-day bills maturing on June 4, 1998 yielded 6.1905 percent from 6.1731.
One- and three-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.56055, 98.55664, 97.09375 and 94.10938 respectively.
